requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid regular foreign passport, be physically and mentally healthy, be friendly to China, and have no criminal record.

Hold a master's degree awarded by an institution accredited by the Chinese Ministry of Education; an expected graduate may use a school-sealed pre-graduation certificate and must obtain the required degree before registration.
Pass HSK Level 6 with at least 210 points, or submit proof that the highest completed education was taught in Chinese for the published exemption.

requirements.ruleText: Complete the application by May 31, 2026; supplementary materials are not accepted after the deadline, and the guide recommends completing the application at least two weeks early.
Register and complete the online application in the Shandong University Application System for International Students; hard copies are not required.
Submit the passport personal-information page from a regular passport valid beyond March 1, 2027.
Submit undergraduate and master's diplomas/degrees or the relevant pre-graduation certificate, plus school-sealed transcripts of all undergraduate and master's courses.

Submit two program-related recommendation letters from professors, associate professors or experts with equivalent titles; each must include a handwritten signature, position, institution, telephone number and email address.
Use SDU's template for the motivation letter and write it in Chinese.
Submit a normally two-year-valid language certificate or, where eligible, a responsible-person-signed and school-sealed letter proving the language of instruction.
Submit a complete Foreign Physical Examination Form with photo, cross-page seal, physician signature and official hospital stamp; the result is valid for six months.
Submit a Certificate of No Criminal Record issued by the local public-security management department and valid within six months before application.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants not covered by the scholarship exemption stated for this degree guide
requirements.ruleText: Submit the applicant's or immediate-family guarantor's passport/ID and proof of deposits of at least RMB 50,000 or equivalent foreign currency.
Submit proof of employment and the table of contents and abstracts of published academic articles when available.

Upload Chinese or English documents, or originals with certified Chinese/English translations; use color scans, not phone photos or photocopies, and do not use handwritten documents except the physical-examination form and signatures.
Complete any document review, interview, written test or other assessment requested by SDU; admission is based on the final evaluation.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 400 application fee after receiving the pre-admission email.
Pay annual tuition of RMB 26,000.
Pay the RMB 800 annual medical-insurance fee; required insurance is necessary to complete registration.
Budget the published accommodation range of RMB 23-45 per person per day according to room type.
Register at the time in the admission letter and present original graduation/degree, language, physical-examination and other required documents; missing originals can disqualify enrollment.
